codelines.name: mocka
codelines.reason: Ticket MOCK3-1 is about fare rules for riders aged 65, and the ticket component names mocka, which is this repository's product area; the fare logic lives in src/fares.ts.

facts.text: Tests are run with `vitest run` (the npm test script) and the build check is `tsc --noEmit`; both must pass before a change is accepted. The bug is on line 9 of src/fares.ts: `if (rider.age > 65)` should be `>= 65` to include riders aged exactly 65 in the concession fare.

codelines.name: mockb
codelines.reason: Ticket MOCK3-2 is about formatStops omitting the final stop on the departure board, and the ticket component names mockb, which is this repository's product area; the schedule rendering logic lives in src/schedule.ts.

facts.text: Tests are run with `vitest run` (the npm test script) and the build check is `tsc --noEmit`; both must pass before a change is accepted. The bug is on line 6 of src/schedule.ts: the loop condition `i < stops.length - 1` skips the last stop; it should iterate through all stops.
